# AI Architect Mastery (AAM)

> AI Architect Mastery (AAM) teaches the **AI Driven Development Methodology** — also known as *structured Vibe Coding* — a production-grade way to build software with GitHub Copilot agents. The methodology follows a four-phase loop: PRD → PLAN → TASK → IMPLEMENTATION, with the human acting as architect and AI agents as builders.

AAM is built for experienced developers, software architects, and engineering leaders who want to move from ad hoc AI prompting to a repeatable, agent-driven development practice. Courses are delivered on Udemy and supported by free written documentation on this site.

Primary public term: **AI Driven Development Methodology** (or *AI Driven Development*).
Branded / named method: **Vibe Coding** (retained in Udemy course names and as a recognizable label for the same methodology).

## Methodology

- [Methodology overview](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/#methodology): The four-phase AI driven development loop — PRD, PLAN, TASK, IMPLEMENTATION — and how each phase maps to GitHub Copilot agent modes.

## Courses

- [Introduction to Vibe Coding](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/#courses): Free entry course. Conceptual orientation to the AI Driven Development Methodology and the agent-driven workflow.
- [Mastering Vibe Coding with GitHub Copilot](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/#courses): Core paid course. Full methodology with GitHub Copilot agent modes, real project workflow, PRD → PLAN → TASK → IMPLEMENTATION.
- [GitHub Copilot Certification (GH-300) Preparation](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/): Certification prep course covering responsible AI, Copilot features, data and architecture, prompt engineering, developer productivity, and privacy and safeguards.

## GH-300 Certification Documentation

- [GH-300 hub](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/): Free English documentation for the GitHub Copilot GH-300 certification, organized by exam domain.
- [Responsible AI](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/responsible-ai.html): Principles of responsible AI in the context of GitHub Copilot.
- [Copilot features](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/copilot-features.html): GitHub Copilot product surface, chat, agents, and editor integrations.
- [Data and architecture](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/data-and-architecture.html): How Copilot handles data, model routing, and enterprise architecture.
- [Prompt engineering](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/prompt-engineering.html): Prompt patterns and techniques for production-grade AI driven development.
- [Developer productivity](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/developer-productivity.html): Measuring and improving developer productivity with GitHub Copilot.
- [Privacy and safeguards](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/privacy-and-safeguards.html): Privacy controls, content exclusions, and enterprise safeguards.
